narr: A nearly stationary thunderstorm on the afternoon of August 16th, 2025 caused flash flooding in the Tucson Metro. Water flooded the streets from curb to curb, roughly 6 inches of moving water, occurred in multiple locations. A nearby rain gauge reported 1.26 inches of rainfall fell in less than 1 hour.

Video on social media shows an estimated 3 inches of water at intersection of Tyndall Rd and 1st Ave. A nearby rain gauge reported 1.26 inches of rainfall fell in less than 1 hour.
Water up past curbs, estimated 6 inches of water, on Tucson Boulevard south of Grant Road. A nearby rain gauge reported 0.29 inches of rainfall fell in less than 1 hour.
